title: STILLNESS: riso lotus poster with heron

techniques.name: Keyline assembly

weight.label: Line weight
weight.note: Weight of the keyline and of the stroked title, as a multiple of the page’s own.

misreg.label: Misregistration
misreg.note: How far the black keyline pass sits off the color fills, as a multiple of the page’s own (about one unit). 0 prints in register.

bleed.label: Ink bleed
bleed.note: How far each ink wanders off its edge (the displacement in its ink filter), as a multiple of its own. 0 prints a clean edge.

pitch.label: Screen ruling
pitch.note: Spacing of every dot and line screen, with its dots and lines grown to keep the same coverage. Above 1 is a coarser screen.

grain.label: Grain
grain.note: The dark grain veil laid over the sheet, as a multiple of the page’s own. 0 leaves the print clean.

dust.label: Dust
dust.note: The white speckle where the ink skipped, as a multiple of the page’s own. 0 clears it.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-rolls every seeded choice the page makes: the paper, grain, dust and the ink filters’ noise. 0 is the page’s own print.

techniques.implementation: Type, a botanical figure and a frame assembled into one sheet in three or four inks. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
